input.summary:
Porches part now builds clean: 0 REFUSED, 0 OFF-PALETTE, 593 placed. The Vallonia and Craftsman porch piers stop at stone and taper post (y2..4) because the roofs part already fills their beam row (y5 z9).</summary>
<parameter name="finished">true
left: Porch beam row y5 z9 on plots 2 and 7 is now the roof's: the roofs part writes lime_terracotta (x35..45) and deepslate_tiles (x114..125) there, so the plan's stripped log beam is gone. Roofs owner should decide whether the roof edge reads as the beam or the beam should move.

Other parts still refuse writes into earlier parts (make.sh log): roofs 83 (plot 5 smooth_quartz vs calcite), glazing 230, chimneys 10, and room parts P3 (about 20) and P5/P7 (about 6). Not in this part's scope; build.nbt is written but those cells are not yet right.
parts-report.json keeps only 8 of the 23 porch refusals in refusedAt, so the full list needed a replay to read.

waste.what: Finding which earlier part owned the refused cells: I wrote a throwaway replay script (/tmp/porch-dbg/who.mjs) that reran the locked parts and printed what sat at each cell.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls and one script; the cell-owner question was answered only by re-running the parts in order.
waste.tool: parts-report.json (or make.sh output) should name the part that owns each refused cell (for example 'roofs wrote lime_terracotta here') and list all refused cells, not 8 samples.

waste.what: Reading the full refusal count: the report said 23 refused but kept only 8 coordinates, so I had to infer the rest.
waste.cost: one extra read of the report plus reasoning about which pier and beam writes were the 23.
waste.tool: runParts report: refusedAt should keep every refused cell with its owner part, or a --refused-only dump.

waste.what: Working around taperedPier to drop only its beam: the helper always writes a beam at y5, so I hand-wrote a small roofedPier (stone + taper post) in porches.mjs.
waste.cost: one helper written locally, 8 pier calls changed.
waste.tool: vocab taperedPier should take beam: null (or a skipOccupied option) so a pier under a roof row needs no local copy.

companions.task: Settle the plot 2 and plot 7 porch roof edge at y5 z9: the roofs part fills the porch beam row, so decide whether the plan's stripped-log beam returns and where, then fix it in roofs.mjs, not in porches.mjs.
Confirm the porch ceiling and beam detail on Vallonia and Craftsman once the roof edge is settled, so the spruce_slab ceiling at y4 and the post tops read as a finished porch.
